mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xia_san_shot WHERE stream_id = #{streamId} AND element_id = #{elementId};
select DISTINCT check_status from xia_san_shot where stream_id = #{streamId} and commit_id in (#{commitId});
SELECT "count"(*) FROM xia_san_shot WHERE stream_id = #{streamId} and commit_id = #{commitId} and check_status in (#{checkStatus}) and 1=1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xia_san_shot (id, stream_id, commit_id, object_id,element_id,check_status, modify_user, modify_time, data) VALUES (#{id}, #{streamId}, #{commitId}, #{objectId},#{elementId} ,#{checkStatus}, #{modifyUser}, #{modifyTime},#{data, typeHandler=org.springblade.modules.sp.utils.JsonTypeHandler});
